## Research

**[The Sprawl Paradox: Redefining American Urbanity Through Density](https://bleonardi.github.io/True_Urban_Ranking_Project/)** · *2025*\
Introduces the True Urban Core (TUC) metric for density-based city ranking. Companion fiscal analysis documents the cross-subsidy of sprawl in the OKI region.

**[Transit Fragmentation: Quantifying Governance Friction](https://bleonardi.github.io/Transit_Fragmentation_Research/)** · *2025*\
Develops the Transit Fragmentation Index (TFI) using NTD data across 480+ urbanized areas.

**[Brent Spence Bridge: Home Price Event Study](https://bleonardi.github.io/BSB_Impact_Analysis/)** · *2025*\
Event study of infrastructure milestone effects on residential prices in Cincinnati/NKY.

**[Canonical Rigidity & Sacred Space: US Catholic Parishes](https://bleonardi.github.io/US_Catholic_Churches/)** · *2025*\
Spatial econometric analysis of parish boundary rigidity and urban land use inefficiency.

**[Do Federal Reserve Banks Research What Their Districts Produce?](https://bleonardi.github.io/Fed_Research_Districts/)** · *2025*\
Topic modeling of ~18,300 Fed working papers against district industry composition.
